Game Overview

Ninja Hero puts players into a ninja experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Ninja Hero comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Ninja Hero?

Ninja Hero is a free ninja game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Ninja Hero free to play?

Yes, Ninja Hero is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
